author: Ubisoft
description:
Formula E 2026 continues!
Weekly Shorts #2 starts on April 26—featuring 5 new tracks designed to blend playful gameplay with Envision, Lola Yamaha ABT, Porsche, Andretti, and Google Cloud.
Free for all. 
Special prizes up for grabs!

🗓️ Week 1: this Sunday, March 15 at 6 PM CET
🗓️ Week 2: April 26–May 3
🗓️ Week 3: May 10–17

ABOUT TRACKMANIA
Welcome to Trackmania — the unique racing game that combines precision and creativity. 

Trackmania® offers a unique, easy-to-learn, hard-to-master gameplay experience with a wide diversity of tracks across five stunning environment (Red Island, Blue Bay, Green Coast, White Shore, and Stadium) along with regular content updates and live events:
- Face new racing challenges with Weekly Shorts and Weekly Grands, a new season every three months, and more player-made tracks featured in the “Track of the Day” selection.
- Compete online in Daily and Weekly Cups, Grand Enduro races, as well as in community-driven and worldwide esports events.

description:
Join us as we take you behind the scenes to see how ships come to life: from early concepts to in-game implementation.

About Skull and Bones:
Enter the perilous world of Skull and BonesTM, where you play by your own rules to rise from a nobody to become the most fearsome pirate kingpin. Craft a variety of unique ships, forge unlikely alliances, and take part in thrilling naval battles as you overcome the odds and bring mayhem on the seas. Be part of an immersive world that introduces new challenges and features every season.
